info.title: Why did strain X clump after washing?

record.procedure: Washing strain X cells during transformation with plasmid P

changes.reason: with the SOP volume the cells were pelleted into a small volume and stuck together while still concentrated

changes.what: Recovery step unchanged from the SOP

record.troubleshooting: Cells clumped after washing on the first try. The clumping came from the wash volume, not the plasmid; doubling the wash volume spread the cells out and the clumping stopped. On the second try 50 ng plasmid was used and the colonies were normal.
